purpose: 100 adversarial seed queries — 50 Type A (time complexity: nested loops + O(n)/O(1) claim) and 50 Type G (string concat: += in loop + O(n) claim). Both patterns reliably trigger the ContradictionDetector nested-loop heuristic. All other types removed after confirming they do not fire against the current detector.

queries.expected_contradiction: O(n) claim + 2 nested loops
